q: In 1 Timothy, what does Paul call Timothy?
a: My true child in the faith
why: Paul was like a spiritual father.
quote: To Timothy, my true child in the faith

q: In 1 Timothy, Paul tells Timothy not to let anyone despise his what?
why: Young people can set an example.
quote: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers

q: In 1 Timothy, why does Paul say Christ Jesus came into the world?
quote: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am the worst.

q: In 1 Timothy, what is called a root of all kinds of evil?
quote: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil.

q: In 1 Timothy, godliness with contentment is what?
why: We brought nothing into the world.
quote: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.

q: In 1 Timothy, Paul tells Timothy to fight the good fight of what?
quote: Fight the good fight of the faith.

q: In 1 Timothy, who is the one mediator between God and men?
why: There is one God and one mediator.
quote: and there is one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus

q: In 1 Timothy, physical exercise has some value, but what is valuable in every way?
why: It holds promise for this life and the next.
quote: but godliness is valuable in every way

q: In 1 Timothy, what did we bring into the world?
quote: For we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it.

q: In 1 Timothy, with what two things should we be content?
quote: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.

q: In 1 Timothy, a person who wants to be an overseer desires what?
quote: If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.

q: In 1 Timothy, in which city did Paul urge Timothy to stay?
quote: you should stay on at Ephesus to instruct certain men not to teach false doctrines

q: In 1 Timothy, what did Paul advise Timothy to use because of his stomach?
quote: Stop drinking only water and use a little wine instead, because of your stomach

q: In 1 Timothy, in which areas should young Timothy set an example?
quote: set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.
